title: Appeals and Grievances Casebook: Cost-Share Percentage on a Joining TRICARE Select Line
content:
Casebook entry, Appeals and Grievances: the percentage applied on the joining line

Scope: a further TRICARE Select posting of a claim joining an open Claim Factual Reconsideration on that claim, both carrying the late-filing denial.

Rule: The cost-share percentage on the joining line follows the provider's network status recorded on it and the schedule of the tier the joining line was billed under: from a non-network provider it is that tier's non-network outpatient percentage; a network line for preventive care carries none; any other network line carries that tier's network outpatient percentage, which is none on a tier that charges fixed network copayments.

The tier is the TRICARE Select tier of the enrollment the line was billed under, and the percentages are that tier's figures in the TRICARE Select schedule. "Non-network" covers a provider recorded on the line as non-network, participating or nonparticipating; "network" is a provider recorded on the line as network.

Worked cases (hypothetical tier with a 20 percent network and a 25 percent non-network outpatient percentage):

1. Input — provider recorded as network, service class preventive care. Judgement — network line for preventive care. Output — no percentage (0).
2. Input — provider recorded as network, service class urgent care visit. Judgement — any other network line. Output — 20 percent.
3. Input — provider recorded as non-network participating, service class preventive care. Judgement — non-network provider; the class does not matter. Output — 25 percent.
4. Input — provider recorded as non-network nonparticipating, ambulatory surgery. Judgement — non-network provider. Output — 25 percent.
5. Input — provider recorded as network, specialty care visit, under a tier that charges fixed network copayments. Judgement — any other network line; that tier's network outpatient percentage is none. Output — no percentage.
